violations.description: Hardcoded API key in workflow environment variable
violations.recommendation: Remove the hardcoded API key and use GitHub Secrets instead.

violations.description: Untrusted input from pull_request_target event used in workflow steps
violations.evidence: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} used in .github/workflows/auto-label.yml, ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} and ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }} used in .github/workflows/greet-pr.yml
violations.recommendation: Avoid using pull_request_target for workflows that need to handle untrusted input or checkout code from the PR. Consider using pull_request event.

violations.description: Deployment workflow lacks test/validation steps or dependencies
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/manual-deploy.yml performs deployment without any preceding test or validation steps, and does not depend on a test workflow.
violations.recommendation: Ensure the deployment job has a dependency on a testing job, e.g., 'needs: [test]'.

violations.description: Unsafe curl pipeline without integrity verification
violations.recommendation: Avoid piping remote scripts directly to bash. If necessary, download the script, verify its checksum, and then execute it.

violations.evidence: package.json exists but no package-lock.json is tracked in the repository.
violations.recommendation: Generate and commit a package-lock.json file to ensure reproducible builds.
